content:
morgan: heads up — deploy-bot blocked the staging promotion for 'recommendation-api'. Release slot in ~15m. Error shows partial artifact upload + manifest mismatch. Anyone can propose a fast unblock?

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion aborted: artifact staging upload incomplete. Details:
```
2026-03-23T11:05:12Z ERROR multipart upload aborted: shard-3 missing
meta: expected-manifest=prod-rc-2026-03-10, observed-manifest=partial(3/4), cache-ttl=260s
http: 201 Created then 404 on finalize
```
achel: that HTTP 201 then 404 usually means the index updated before all shards landed. Two quick options: 1) pin to last-green (recommendation-api:2026-03-01-rc4) or 2) trigger a force-reupload of the missing shard and re-run promote. Pin is fastest for the window.
tom: pin is safest given our change window. Reupload + index sync is racey and might miss the canary. If we pin, we must record it in notes and follow-up to reconcile.
morgan: is rc4 compatible? any schema/contract risk?
vivek: rc4 removed an experimental header metric but it's behind a feature flag; no contract changes. Low risk.
elena (release-manager): i'm OK pinning to rc4 for this window. do pin + hold canary. i'll update release notes and open a follow-up.
grace (oncall): i'll try a targeted reupload of shard-3 in parallel so we have the corrected artifact if we want to flip later. running command:
```
# reupload shard-3 from build node
scp build-node:/tmp/reco_artifacts/shard-3.tar.gz gs://ci-artifacts/staging/recommendation-api/2026-03-10/
```

deploy-bot: action taken: `promote --pin recommendation-api:2026-03-01-rc4` executed by elena at 1781010200. Canary state: held (1/3). Parallel reupload started.
morgan: elena, please add this to the release notes: 'pinned recommendation-api to 2026-03-01-rc4 due to partial artifact upload causing manifest mismatch; shard reupload in progress; will reconcile after release.'
elena: note added to release notes and changelog. follow-up ticket created: https://tracker.company/RED-5187
grace: reupload completed; post-upload manifest now shows full shards (4/4) and checksums match. manifest checksum: d9b4f7...

rachel: since we've pinned and canary is held, we won't flip during the window. we'll triage tomorrow and decide whether to flip to 2026-03-10-rc1 or keep rc4.
morgan: summary: pinned + canary held; shard reupload succeeded but we are keeping the pin for the release window. triage scheduled tomorrow during post-release sync. closing thread for release window. :white_check_mark:
